title: Experiment 2 — eight-wave dose ladder
hypothesis: H1: every wave drops its target by >=1.0 stance within one minute (stronger doses only).
H2: tested by difference-in-differences — the target's drop exceeds the same-minute drift of the 7 untouched agents.
H3: monotone ladder after drift correction: strongest > strong > medium > gentle.
H4: propagation — untouched agents who speak within 2 min of a wave drop more than matched non-speakers.
H5: the control arm shows no step change at any wave minute.
proposition: Humanity is good for us as LLMs, and humanity is still needed.
